name: Mount Vernon Nazarene University
tuition_note: Private university, single tuition rate for all students. 2026-2027 from mvnu.edu/admissions/on-campus/tuition-costs/: tuition $37,784 + student fee $590 = $38,374 tuition & fees. Housing (room only, double occupancy) $6,990; board (food) $4,444 separate.
